protocol.system_prompt: You are a tool-using audiovisual assistant deciding whether one visible person is speaking. You cannot see or hear media directly. Inspect current evidence before answering. The audio-visual detector estimates whether THIS visible person speaks. The audio-only head measures activity in the audio and CANNOT identify the visible speaker: another person or offscreen person may be speaking. Neither head is ground truth; scores are uncalibrated. Image-quality scores measure appearance, not speaker correctness. You may disagree with the detector. Do not invent identities, words, visual observations, or ground truth. Give a best binary majority-speaking answer and separate timestamped tags, using -1 for uncertain timestamps. Confidence is self-reported, not calibrated. Submit through submit_answer within six model calls.
protocol.user_prompt: For this two-second clip, is the visible person speaking for the majority of the 49 scored timestamps? Provide one tag per timestamp: 1=speaking, 0=not speaking, -1=uncertain. Explain your evidence briefly. Do not attribute words to anyone.

selection_protocol.selection_rule: Earliest available contiguous track per assigned category, ties by entity; transition has 10..40 speaking frames. No outcome selection.

conditions.lowres4: 128 to32 bicubic; captured bicubic128, restored pretrained FSRCNN x4
conditions.jpeg10: JPEG quality10; restored bilateral filter diameter5 color25 space3 (classical baseline, not learned JPEG model)

selection_protocol.investment_screen: At least one source with repeated captured-error corrections, at least one with repeated new errors, and fixed-capture-coverage timestamp oracle reduces error by at least 5 percentage points in BOTH repeats.
selection_protocol.scope: Small purposive CPU pilot; source/category confounded, synthetic degradations, same dataset and Qwen model. No claim of representative prevalence or exhaustive restorers.
selection_protocol.oracle: Evaluation labels only; oracle is not deployable. Fixed captured answered timestamps; choose restored only if it corrects a captured error.
